description: CI x86-64 failed after fz-21x.11: compiler2_compile_root_jit_consumes_native_program and compiler2_native_program_jit_runs_variadic_extern_through_compiler2_codegen read open() on a missing path as 4294967295. C int returns leave the upper 32 bits of rax zero on x86-64 glibc; arm64 libcs write a full 64-bit -1, which masked it on macOS. The deleted open dispatcher cast to c_int; every int-returning libc function (open, printf, close, unlink, creat, abs) is declared :: integer, so the fixed-arity path has the same latent gap. Fix: wire spelling c_int -> ExternTy::I32 (lane I32; param ireduce, return sextend; interp reads i32; variadic tail stays a 64-bit word; c_int returns sign-extended in the trampoline). Redeclare the libc functions. Fixture pinning a negative int return on all doors. Docs: wire alphabet table in externs.md and the guide.
title: c_int wire spelling: a C int return reads back as 4294967295 on x86-64 once declared integer
